info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Payments-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payment Retrieval API provides access to a list of utility billing payments, enabling users to manage and analyze payment records effectively. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed information about payments made for utility services, supporting billing management and customer service operations. Typical users include billing administrators and finance teams who require insights into payment histories and trends. Through this API, organizations can ensure accurate and timely information is available for business decision-making.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about billing payments, providing users with insights into their payment status, history, and associated details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment billing information. Ensure that the request includes all necessary data to process the payment retrieval properly.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations related to billing and payment. It is expected to be a string format.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.title: Billing Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the payment operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the payment operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the GET operation on billing payment.
